maya: deploy-bot paused promotion for tag=release-2026.07.21 — several staging canaries failed on cache-restore and workspace collisions.

deploy-bot: "promotion paused for tag=release-2026.07.21, reason=ci/cache-restore-race x3 failures"

ops-jun: runner logs show cache fetch returned a checksum that doesn't match the index, then mkdir conflicts during restore: `mkdir /ws/run-159: file exists`.

dev-lee: paste: ```WARN cache fetch mismatch expected=sha256:111 got=sha256:112
ERROR overlay: apply diff failed
mkdir /ws/run-159: file exists```

sre-zoe: no infra deploys in last 6h. Host-level IO spikes on pool-b at 03:12 UTC. Could be concurrent cache prune + restore racing.

maya: change window closes in ~50m. Options: (1) manual pin to last-good image (release-2026.07.14), (2) force re-run canaries with CI_CACHE_BUST and CI_SERIAL_NAMESPACE (adds ~20m), (3) delay window.

release-mgr: pin seems safest to guarantee the cut. We'll document and follow up with SRE to investigate runner prune timing.

dev-lee: if we rerun, use `CI_CACHE_BUST=true CI_SERIAL_NAMESPACE=true RUNNER_RETRY=5` to reduce collision risk. But if hosts have IO issues it might still fail.

sre-zoe: I'll open ENG-4122 for runner forensic and pause scheduled cache-prune jobs on pool-b.

deploy-bot: heuristic recommendation: prefer pin_previous_image when canary pass <80% or infra errors detected.

release-mgr: decision: manual promote previous stable image release-2026.07.14 to meet change window. I'll run promote and add release note. Maya, please own ENG-4122.

maya: taking ENG-4122, creating ticket and attaching logs. deploy-bot: please run `promote --image=release-2026.07.14 --reason="canary-cache-restore-race"`.

deploy-bot: Promotion queued.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Production tag now points to release-2026.07.14. :white_check_mark:

maya: release note drafted: "Production cut pinned to 2026.07.14 due to staging canary cache-restore races; follow-up ENG-4122 opened." We'll rerun serialized canaries after ENG-4122 triage. Close thread once ENG-4122 has initial RCA. :lock:
